intent: Distinguish postponement and classroom waiting from individual confirmed collection; interpret marked exits, staff instructions and clear-route requirements in this fictional site briefing.

items.label: 把警报条件、指令来源和行动顺序接起来
items.prompt: Set whose instructions to follow and what takes priority in this briefing.
items.answer: Follow the site staff’s emergency directions and keep the route clear; do not put collecting bags first.
items.reason: if an alarm sounds给触发条件，staff’s directions给指令来源。导游要求按应急指令，而不是自定先取物品的计划，并保持通道畅通。这是本段场地简报的理解练习，不能自行编造真实出口位置或转弯路线。
